name: Megapnosaurus
sum: Small coelophysid theropod from the Early Jurassic of Africa, formerly known as Syntarsus, about 2.2 m long.
wsnote: Up to about 2.2 m and 13 kg according to Wikipedia revision 1361250795.
holotype: QG 1, a well-preserved postcranial skeleton lacking skull and neck vertebrae — Forest Sandstone, Zimbabwe.
material: Many articulated partial skeletons from a second locality in Zimbabwe, plus material from South Africa and China.
biology: A small to medium-sized, lightly built, ground-dwelling, bipedal carnivore.
author: Ivie et al. 2001
